topic: a fictional countertop herb-growing kit for small kitchens
audience: adults who rent small flats and would like fresh herbs without much effort
cta: Find Pebblenook at the link in the description.

presenter.description: a woman in her early thirties with shoulder-length wavy dark brown hair, brown eyes and a relaxed friendly expression
presenter.wardrobe: an olive green knit sweater and a thin gold chain
presenter.room: a bright kitchen with a wooden table, a window and a few potted plants

claims.text: Pebblenook arrives as a complete kit with seed pods, soil and a small tray.
The tray fits on a standard windowsill.
A printed guide for beginners comes in the box.
